title: /cam-plan <id> targeting e no-op + issue specified fica rank:None (unplannable)
description: Dois defeitos acoplados que impediram planejar CAM-201 explicitamente. (1) /cam-plan <id> escreve plan_issue no cam-loop.local.md mas runPlanPhase.selectIssueFn (selectPlannableFromFile) IGNORA plan_issue e pega o top-RANKED plannable, entao targeting explicito e no-op (classe CAM-157: buildPlannerTaskPrompt nomeia o issue SELECIONADO, nao o pedido). (2) specifyIssueOnMain deixa rank:None; a selecao ordena por rank asc e um issue sem rank fica por ultimo / nao e selecionado, entao um issue recem-specificado (CAM-201, WSJF 5.0) nunca e planejado enquanto um ranked de WSJF menor (CAM-66 rank 13, WSJF 2.0) e escolhido. Fix: honrar plan_issue em selectIssueFn quando setado (target explicito ganha), e/ou atribuir rank provisorio no specify (ou cair no WSJF quando rank e null). Vivido 2026-07-06: /cam-plan CAM-201 planejou CAM-66.

spec.scope: Make explicit plan targeting honor the requested issue and make freshly-specified issues plannable. (1) runPlanPhase.selectIssueFn honors plan_issue from cam-loop.local.md when set, so an explicit /cam-plan <id> target wins over top-ranked selection. (2) A freshly-specified issue with rank:None is not silently unplannable: assign a provisional rank at specify time or fall back to WSJF in the selection sort when rank is null.
acceptanceCriteria: When cam-loop.local.md has a non-empty plan_issue, runPlanPhase selects that exact issue (when plannable) rather than the top-ranked one; a unit test proves the explicit target wins over a higher-ranked other issue. [oracle: named-command bun test]

A specified+open issue with rank:None is selectable by the plan-runner (provisional rank at specify time, or a WSJF fallback in the selection sort); a test proves an unranked high-WSJF issue is not skipped in favor of a lower-WSJF ranked one.
If plan_issue names an issue that is missing / not-open / not-plannable, the plan-runner fails with a clear error rather than silently planning a different issue.
gotchas: Lived 2026-07-06: /cam-plan CAM-201 planned CAM-66 because CAM-201 was rank:None and plan_issue was ignored.
CAM-157 fixed buildPlannerTaskPrompt to NAME the selected issue but did not fix the SELECTION to honor plan_issue.
